Tales of Solaria · Act II

Two Flames

A brother and a sister, separated by one snowy morning, each sure the other is dead. Walk Oōdengard's road and Alara's road in either order. Neither of them knows the whole story. By the end, you will.

Controls

Arrows / WASDMove Z / J / SpaceAttack, talk, read, confirm X / K / ShiftRoll (dodge through attacks) C / LSkill: Guard, Flute Gust or Cube Ice E / HEat something from your pouch (heals) V / Q / TabSoul Sight, or swap siblings at the end Esc / PJournal and the Truths you have pieced together MSound on or off

What happens next?

Oōdengard is gone. Alara wears the green and gold. The Rifts are sleeping, for now.

Somewhere past the horizon, a black-haired girl is learning to sail. Her story is Act 2.5: The Age of Pirates.
